formulas.kev: Question-weighted hard accuracy; summed one-hot multiclass Brier; 10 equal-width bins of top confidence against hard correctness; NLL from recorded logits where available, otherwise probability floor 1e-9. Only n/accuracy/Brier/ECE/NLL independently accepted here.
formulas.nimble: Hard-reference argmax accuracy; one-hot summed multiclass Brier; Noul binary Brier=(p_true-y)^2 separately; top-confidence hard ECE10; NLL on reference class; score MAE=abs(probability-expected level-reference level), in original level units. Civil distribution JSD uses base 2; TV=0.5*sum(abs(p-q)).
formulas.typed: Each question has equal weight. Accuracy compares first argmax(p) with first argmax(q). Original rounded gold masses are not renormalized; prediction probabilities are normalized. KL(q||p) uses floor 1e-9; Brier=sum((p-q)^2); ECE10 uses hard argmax correctness/top probability. Strict and original arithmetic both retained; these are probability arithmetic results, not full native wire/HTTP reproduction.
formulas.openjev: Hard accuracy only on 10046 one-hot rows; all-row expected accuracy=mean(q[argmax(p)]), NLL=-mean(sum(q*log(p))), Brier=mean(sum((p-q)^2)), expected Brier=Brier+mean(1-sum(q^2)); all-row denominator 10532. ECE15 uses expected correctness q[argmax(p)] and top confidence.
